turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
PM
1:43 PM. You said:

How do I use it properly the very first time?

01:43 PM

Hi,
The first time, soak the ceramic part in water, fill your water container, place the end of the tube in that water, insert the stake into moist soil, and then adjust it gradually rather than making big turns.

The key is to start with already-moist soil so the blumat can maintain moisture instead of trying to rescue very dry soil. Once it is set, give it a little time to respond before adjusting again.
